changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE seq RECORD; highest NUMERIC; BEGIN FOR seq IN SELECT s.sequence_schema, s.sequence_name, c.table_name FROM information_schema.sequences s JOIN information_schema.columns c ON c.table_schema = s.sequence_schema AND c.table_name = regexp_replace(s.sequence_name, '_seq$', '') AND c.column_name = 'id' AND c.data_type IN ('numeric', 'integer', 'bigint', 'smallint') WHERE s.sequence_schema = 'clinlims' AND s.sequence_name LIKE '%\_seq' LOOP EXECUTE format('SELECT max(id) FROM %I.%I', seq.sequence_schema, seq.table_name) INTO highest; IF highest IS NOT NULL AND highest >= 1 AND highest < 9223372036854775807 THEN EXECUTE format( 'SELECT setval(%L, greatest(%s, (SELECT last_value FROM %I.%I)))', seq.sequence_schema || '.' || seq.sequence_name, floor(highest)::bigint, seq.sequence_schema, seq.sequence_name); END IF; END LOOP; END $$;
